description: This file defines the DestroyReportToPurgeStrategy class within the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin. The class is responsible for purging report data associated with a specific employee, identified by their employee number, by removing relevant entities from the database.

classes.name: DestroyReportToPurgeStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class implementing a specific report purge method based on employee associations within the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Deletes report entities related to a given employee number by matching subordinate and supervisor relationships and removing the corresponding records.
